# A document that loads the index package itself

Quarto emits the extension's package load conditionally, so a document that
has already loaded `imakeidx` keeps its own options — and without
`noautomatic` the index file is closed at the marker, dropping every term
marked below it. Nothing the filter emits can reach a load that already
happened, so the case is made loud rather than fixed: the document renders,
and LaTeX warns at begin-document that entries will be missing.

One term is marked before the marker: [zeta]{.index}.

::: {.qi-index-here}
:::

# After the marker

One term is marked after it, [omega]{.index}, which is the term this document
exists to show going missing.
